title: A real failed 0.89 temporal verification must become a durable failed candidate, not invisible history
root_cause: The existing canonical submit_asset router returned MIRA_CONTINUOUS_VIDEO_PROOF_REQUIRED on true HTTP 200 temporal confidence 0.89 versus unchanged 0.90 minimum, but failed to record that alternate OpenArt history in media job/Brain. The previous 0.920 rejected ORIGINAL remained the only visible error. The next agent could unknowingly retry the same already rejected candidate.
fix: Only when existing temporal verifier returns HTTP 200 and a valid observed confidence <0.90, atomically record rejected history/score on SAME media job/obligation with original CAS, add one idempotent Brain failure occurrence, and prohibit retry of exact rejected candidate. Permit only a genuinely new same-source/project/master candidate to enter original strict verification, retaining original final hash/face/temporal/one-shot provider checks.
prevention_rule: Never silently overwrite a genuine media proof rejection with readiness polls; never count low-confidence temporal verdict as PASS; never replay exact rejected asset after a measured fail; never treat 401/403 or transport error as quality rejection.
release_gates: Protected merge and production source parity
Original router real next candidate proof; no fake video PASS
One original publisher, exact Meta ID and readback, no duplicate schedulers
outcome: Source candidate only; 0.89 video stays rejected, Instagram not published.
